candidates.title: Mirendil introduces Fern 0.1, its first from-scratch pretrained model with a context window of up to 10M tokens
candidates.reason: Weighted 68.15 < 80. Official post read ("Published: October 26, 2026, 8:00 am PT", in window) and its embedded figure data parsed: Fern 0.1 = Mirendil-Base (0.1-0.5T params) after short post-training, up to 10M tokens; RULER on Mirendil-Base 100% single needle at 32K-10M, 90% multi-key and 45% HotpotQA multi-hop at 10M (20 examples at 10M); agentic table Fern 0.1 vs Claude Opus 5.5: SWE-Bench Verified 73.4 vs 98.2, DeepSWE v1.1 44.2 vs 74.2, Terminal Bench 4.0 6.1 vs 66.4. All results are company-reported, no paper or weights, access "coming soon" (early-access form only), so not reproducible or independently verified. Related earlier candidate c20261022-mirendil-base covered the Oct 21 pretraining post; Fern is the new model release.

candidates.title: FrontierCS 2 rerun: Gemini 4 Argon goes from 39.6% to 54.2% pass rate after switching from the Pi harness to Antigravity, which retries refused requests
candidates.reason: Weighted 63.0 < 80. Leaderboard page read ("Last updated: October 25, 2026"): notes that in 10 of 48 Pi runs a provider content-filter refusal ended the run, while Antigravity retries; Claude Opus 5.5 leads at 58.3% per X posts.
